title: What's the USB trident symbol for? How to know what kind of port you have - Engadget
summary: Red ports, while not as common, usually signify either USB 10Gbps (originally USB 3.1) or USB 20Gbps (originally USB 3.2). Its official marketing names, USB 20Gbps and USB 40Gbps , match the USB 3 revisions discussed earlier.
